Q1: Implement editors may be unable to write `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py`. How should this issue land the live-hook fix?
Choices:
A) Implement only: copy the template into the live hook, byte for byte, plus a changelog fragment. If the sandbox drops the `.claude/` write, the run fails with `BLOCKED:`.
B) No code change: close the issue as an operator step and send the gap to the held `ai/sync-claude-live-copies-held` sync PR for a human to review and merge.
C) Try A first. If the `.claude/` write is refused or dropped, record an `ai:operator-step` entry pointing at the held sync PR (or at a manual live-copy update), then close the issue. (RECOMMENDED)
